config_name: iPad Pro 13-inch — M5 (10-core CPU/10-core GPU), 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 13" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED + Magic Keyboard

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard included in price: scissor keys (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total. Nano-texture glass option +$150.

battery.notes: Apple claims 10h web/video on Wi-Fi. Users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tablet-only $2,929.99 (BBY 19495708 / apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard 13" $449.99 (BBY 17932868). Nano-texture +$150 optional. Apple Pencil Pro $168.99 not included.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 2929.99 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: An extremely fast M5 SoC and Wi-Fi 7. Pros: extremely fast M5 SoC, sturdy and timeless case, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G, good camera quality for a tablet, powerful speaker sound, comprehensive software package, good battery life, bright and accurate display. Cons: no power adapter included, very expensive, PWM flickering, no always-on display, only a 12-month warranty. (NBC review of the iPad Pro 11" M5 2025, 90% very good; same SoC and panel family across 11"/13" tiers.)

praises: 16GB RAM unlocks the genuinely pro apps — LumaFusion multitrack 4K, large PS/Affinity files, on-device AI models stop hitting memory ceilings
Tandem OLED is the best display on any tablet — true blacks at 1000-nit SDR with 120Hz ProMotion
1TB with nano-texture option is the closest a tablet has ever gotten to a pro reference display
M5 with 10-core CPU tops most thin-and-light laptops in short bursts
Thunderbolt + 16GB makes external-SSD video workflows actually viable
complaints: With keyboard this is $3,379 — squarely MacBook Pro territory while iPadOS still blocks desktop-class apps
16GB RAM is gated behind the 1TB tier; paying for storage you may not need just to get memory
Apple's +$550 for 1TB over 512GB is absurd vs any third-party SSD
Magic Keyboard at $449.99 still has unlit keys at this price
Stage Manager external-monitor support still janky; single USB-C port and no headphone jack

design_philosophy: Apple's halo tablet at its most uncompromising: the 1TB tier is the first 13" Pro to pair the full 10-core M5 with 16GB unified memory, which is what the pro creative apps actually demand. This is the config Apple quietly markets to video and music professionals — the storage is the ticket to the RAM. With the Magic Keyboard priced in it costs as much as a real laptop, and the honest question remains whether iPadOS earns that.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Pro M5 13" (90%, gap-fill 2026-11-24).
